name: Minmetals New Energy Materials(Hunan)Co.,Ltd.
summary: Minmetals New Energy Materials(Hunan)Co.,Ltd. is involved in the research, development, production, and sale of battery materials. The company offers ternary cathode materials, multi-material precursors, multi-material positive electrode materials, multi-component cathode materials, lithium iron phosphate, lithium cobalt oxide and other lithium battery cathode materials, spherical nickel and nickel-metal hydride battery cathode materials. It also offers processing services. The company was formerly known as Hunan Changyuan Lico Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Minmetals New Energy Materials(Hunan)Co.,Ltd. in August 2025. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Changsha, China.
